item: 1.3 Prompt history — ArrowUp first takes the caret to the first character; only from there does it recall the previous prompt (2026-11-22)
branch: The composer's keydown handler in js/65-slash.js. On the first line with a collapsed caret that is NOT at offset 0, a plain ArrowUp moves the caret to offset 0 and recalls nothing; at offset 0 it recalls the previous prompt and leaves the caret at offset 0, so walking further back stays one press per prompt. A selection, or Shift held, is left to the browser. ArrowDown is unchanged: on the last line it steps forward and puts the caret at the end.
provenance: No wire frames: this is composer key handling, driven with synthetic keydown events on #input (a synthetic event runs our handler but not the browser's default caret move, which is why the handler moves the caret itself). `history` / `histIdx` / `histDraft` are the composer's own state, set directly and restored in the last step. USER REQUEST 2026-11-22: 'clicking up key to go to first character before going to previous message' — before the change ArrowUp anywhere on the first line recalled at once and replaced a half-edited line. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-11-22 against the 242 sandbox still serving the pre-change webview: 6 passed, 7 failed — both step-1 asserts (it recalled 'second prompt' at once), steps 2-3 (one prompt further along than expected, caret at the end) and both step-5 asserts (a selection was recalled over); step 0, the step-1 'consumed' assert, step 3's text, the ArrowDown asserts and the restore are GUARDs or pass on both builds.

steps.note: 0 — two sent prompts in history, a half-typed draft in the composer with the caret at its end
steps.setup: window.__h106 = { history: history.slice(), idx: histIdx, draft: histDraft, value: input.value }; closeMenus(); history = ['first prompt', 'second prompt']; histIdx = 2; histDraft = ''; input.value = 'draft text'; input.focus(); input.setSelectionRange(10, 10); window.__k106 = (function(k){ var e = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:k, bubbles:true, cancelable:true}); input.dispatchEvent(e); return e.defaultPrevented; });

steps.note: 1 — ArrowUp with the caret inside the line goes to the first character and recalls nothing
steps.setup: window.__r106 = window.__k106('ArrowUp'); window.__s106 = { v: input.value, s: input.selectionStart, e: input.selectionEnd };

expect.why: the draft is still in the composer (pre-fix: 'second prompt')
the caret is at the first character
we moved the caret ourselves, so the key is consumed

steps.note: 2 — ArrowUp again, now at the first character, recalls the previous prompt and keeps the caret at the start
steps.setup: window.__k106('ArrowUp'); window.__s106 = { v: input.value, s: input.selectionStart, e: input.selectionEnd };

expect.why: caret at the start, so the next ArrowUp steps back at once (pre-fix: 13,13)

steps.note: 3 — one more ArrowUp steps straight to the prompt before it: one press per prompt while walking back
steps.setup: window.__k106('ArrowUp'); window.__s106 = { v: input.value, s: input.selectionStart, e: input.selectionEnd };

expect.why: one press, no caret detour (the caret was already at the start)

steps.note: 4 — ArrowDown is unchanged: forward one prompt with the caret at the end, then back to the stashed draft
steps.setup: window.__k106('ArrowDown'); window.__a106 = { v: input.value, s: input.selectionStart, e: input.selectionEnd }; window.__k106('ArrowDown'); window.__b106 = { v: input.value, s: input.selectionStart, e: input.selectionEnd };

expect.why: GUARD: forward one, caret at the end
GUARD: the half-typed draft survived the round trip

steps.note: 5 — a selection that starts at the first character is not a caret: ArrowUp recalls nothing and is left to the browser; then restore
steps.setup: input.setSelectionRange(0, 5); window.__r106 = window.__k106('ArrowUp'); window.__s106 = { v: input.value, s: input.selectionStart, e: input.selectionEnd }; history = window.__h106.history; histIdx = window.__h106.idx; histDraft = window.__h106.draft; input.value = window.__h106.value; autoGrow();

expect.why: nothing recalled over a selection (pre-fix: 'second prompt')
not consumed — the browser collapses the selection as usual
